title: Personal Credit Cards: Last Statement Balance as a Ceiling on the Closing Autopay Amount
content:
On Personal Credit Cards, the card's last statement balance caps the fixed sum of a closing automatic payment; that balance is the new balance shown on the card's most recent statement.

## Rule

The fixed sum never goes above the last statement balance. Should the ledger figure exceed the last statement balance, the statement figure is used in its place; when it is equal or lower, the ledger figure stands.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

| Balance owed from the ledger | Last statement balance | Figure carried forward |
|---|---|---|
| 1453.40 USD | 1390.12 USD | 1390.12 USD |
| 1453.40 USD | 1453.40 USD | 1453.40 USD |
| 1453.40 USD | 1600.00 USD | 1453.40 USD |

Purchases or charges posted since the most recent statement can lift the ledger figure above the statement; the ceiling keeps the fixed sum at what the statement showed.
